summary: Recursive BVH (bounding-volume hierarchy) traversal for collision queries (per-frame tick, called by SpatialGridQuery 0x0044C4C0). Reads the node type word at this+0x8: negative values mark a leaf that runs QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest against the surface pointer stored in the node (this+0x10), with the sentinel 0xFFFE additionally testing a second surface at surface+92. Non-negative values mark an interior node: it computes a split coordinate from the query a2 using the axis tables indexed by the split-axis word at this+0xA (global 0x007CA3A4) with a sign selection from the node, recurses into the child subtree (this+0x1C) when the split coordinate falls inside the child bounding interval, then walks the next sibling (this+0x20) while the split coordinate remains within the next node's bound (this+0x24), re-checking the leaf sentinel after each step.

local_names.this: BVH node header: type/sentinel word at +0x8, split axis at +0xA, split sign at +0xC, surface/child pointer at +0x10, child bounds at +0x1C, next sibling at +0x20, next bound at +0x24
local_names.a2: query vector used to compute the split coordinate
local_names.v2: current node pointer (moves to next sibling during the walk)
local_names.v3: node type word (negative = leaf, 0xFFFE = two-surface leaf, non-negative = interior)
local_names.v7: split coordinate (v5 - v6 or v6 + v5 depending on the sign selection)

operations.description: Read the node type word v3 from this+0x8 at entry.
Leaf dispatch: when v3 (word at this+0x8) is negative the node is a leaf and execution takes the surface-test path.
Leaf primary test: QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest(surface, a2) against the surface pointer at this+0x10, updating closest-hit data.
Two-surface sentinel: when the word at this+0x8 equals 0xFFFE, additionally run QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest against the secondary surface at surface+92.

Interior split coordinate: v5 = axis_table[split-axis at this+0xA] * a2[0] and v6 = axis_table_other[split-axis at this+0xA] * a2[2], then v7 = v5 - v6 or v6 + v5 selected by the node sign word (this+0xC), using the axis table global 0x007CA3A4.
Child subtree range test: when the split coordinate falls inside the child bounding interval (bounds carried at this+0x1C), recurse BVHTreeTraversal(a2) into the child subtree.

Sibling walk: advance to the next sibling node pointer (this+0x20) and continue while the split coordinate is not below the next node's lower bound and not above its upper bound (bound at this+0x24); the loop re-reads the node type word at +0x8 after each step and re-enters the leaf surface-test path when it turns negative.
Invoked by SpatialGridQuery (0x0044C4C0) to resolve which surfaces a query intersects.

unresolved: The exact node layout mapping the packet fields (bounds at this+0x1C, next sibling at this+0x20, next bound at this+0x24) onto the raw pointer/float arithmetic (v8[0]/v8[1], v9+4, *(next+1)) follows the skeleton fill at DERIVED trust and is not independently verified here.

The axis table is rendered by the raw source as both dword_7CA388 and the indexed float access unk_7CA3A4; only the single global 0x007CA3A4 is granted by the packet, so the second table address is not referenced as an evidence ref.
